The learner asks specifically: Make sure one of the senses is this meaning: to make something not dirty.

notes: This verb is a compound of 'lau' (to wipe) and 'dọn' (to tidy/clear away). It is commonly used for household chores.
While 'dọn dẹp' focuses more on tidying up and organizing items, 'lau dọn' specifically emphasizes the act of cleaning surfaces or removing dirt.

senses.definition: To remove dirt from surfaces or make a space clean.

examples.text: Tôi cần lau dọn nhà cửa vào cuối tuần này.
examples.translation: I need to clean the house this weekend.
examples.emotion: slightly busy and determined, preparing for a productive weekend

senses.definition: To put things in their proper place and organize a room.

examples.text: Anh ấy đang lau dọn bàn làm việc cho gọn gàng.
examples.translation: He is tidying up his desk to keep it organized.
examples.emotion: calm and focused, enjoying the process of organizing
